description: Weather and seasons (packages/core/docs/weather-seasons.md §3): which season an absolute day falls in, what that season’s sky can bring, how harsh a condition is, and what it closes. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/weather/weather-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run weather-corpus`; the authored valley is emitted by the module’s own weatherClimateFacts, so the corpus cannot describe a climate the runtime does not publish. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack over the game-AI substrate: it writes one more clause for forbids/4 — which ai/action-predicates.ts declares dynamic — and therefore declares it here itself so the cases run standalone. weather/1, season/1 and day_number/1 are ADOPTED from this build’s existing vocabulary (prolog/gameplay-predicates.ts, prolog/npc-reasoning.ts) rather than re-minted; this module is simply the first thing in core that WRITES the first two, which is the whole of what raising it from v1 meant. Every number is a whole day or a 0–100 severity and there is not one float in the pack, because a climate four engines must agree on may not turn on one. The calendar is a single rule over resolved sums — season_start/2 and year_length/1 are emitted RESOLVED, because summing a list needs findall/3 and a pack that reaches for a library is a pack three native engines cannot consult verbatim. mod is floor-based, so a day before the epoch lands inside the year rather than outside it, and an engine whose remainder truncates toward zero fails exactly one case here. What is NOT here is the seeded progression: the roll that turns a clear morning into a storm and the persistence that keeps it there are integer arithmetic no rule computes, pinned day by day in conformance/weather/progression.json. Nor is permissible/3, which belongs to conformance/prolog/agent-ai.json — that a snowbound errand is actually refused is proved end to end in src/weather/__tests__/permissibility.test.ts.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-no-calendar-and-does-not-raise
kb: season_of_day(Day, S) :- nonvar(Day), year_length(L), L > 0, D is Day mod L, season_start(S, Start), season_length(S, Len), D >= Start, End is Start + Len, D < End.
season_day_of(Day, N) :- season_of_day(Day, S), year_length(L), D is Day mod L, season_start(S, Start), N is D - Start.
season_next(S, T) :- season_start(S, Start), season_length(S, Len), year_length(L), L > 0, Next is (Start + Len) mod L, season_start(T, Next).
weather_possible(S, C) :- weather_kind(C), weather_chance(S, C, W), W > 0.
weather_harsh(C) :- weather_severity(C, V), weather_harsh_above(T), V > T.
